name: Samelisant
summary: Samelisant is an experimental wakefulness-promoting agent acting as a selective histamine H3 receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of narcolepsy. It was also under development for the treatment of cognition disorders and Parkinson's disease, but no recent development has been reported for these indications.
